exercises.question: What does «Estará en casa» probably mean here? [¿Qué significa probablemente «Estará en casa» aquí?]
options: He/She is probably at home. [Probablemente está en casa.]
He/She was at home yesterday. [Estuvo en casa ayer.]
He/She must leave home. [Tiene que salir de casa.]

exercises.sentence: __ en casa, pero no estoy seguro. (estar) [He/She is probably at home, but I am not sure.]
exercises.english: He/She will probably be at home, but I am not sure.
Something similar will probably happen next year.

sentences: Primero, no veo a Ana en la oficina. [First, I do not see Ana at the office.]
Después, pienso: estará en casa. [Then I think: she is probably at home.]
Finalmente, la llamaré para confirmarlo. [Finally, I will call her to confirm it.]

exercises.question: Which word means «uncertainty»? [¿Qué palabra significa «incertidumbre»?]
options: incertidumbre [uncertainty]
previsión [forecast]
probable [likely]

exercises.sentence: La __ indica que quizá habrá cambios. (forecast) [The forecast indicates that there may be changes.]
exercises.english: The forecast indicates that there may be changes.
The train will arrive late if there are problems on the line.

options: It is probably eight o'clock when I arrive.
It was eight o'clock yesterday.
It will be eight o'clock tomorrow.

exercises.sentence: Probablemente sucederá algo parecido el año que viene.
options: Something similar will probably happen next year.
Something similar happened last year.
Nothing similar can happen.

exercises.sentence: Estará en casa, pero no estoy seguro.
exercises.english: He will be at home, but I am not sure.

options: Estará en casa, pero no estoy seguro. [She is probably at home, but I am not sure.]
Esté en casa, pero no estoy seguro. [She be at home, but I am not sure.]
Estuvo en casa, pero no estoy seguro. [She was at home, but I am not sure.]
Probablemente sucederá algo parecido. [Something similar will probably happen.]
Probablemente sucedió algo parecido. [Something similar probably happened.]
No sucedió nada parecido. [Nothing similar happened.]
No, todavía existe cierta incertidumbre. [No, there is still some uncertainty.]
No, todavía exista cierta incertidumbre. [No, there still be (subjunctive) some uncertainty.]
No, la previsión es una persona. [No, the forecast is a person.]

template.prompt: Make a prediction using the future.
template.answer: Probablemente sucederá algo parecido el año que viene.

template.prompt: Use the future to make a guess about the present.
template.answer: Estará en casa, pero no estoy seguro.
